reviewer_notes: The paper defines three specific-consumption EPIs (SCPU, SCRU, SCDU) and categorises all three (Table 4), and states two canonical discriminant functions are obtained per EPI. Only the SCPU regression model is presented in detail (F1 coefficients in Eq. 9, R2=0.9029), so a single model (M1) is recorded; SCRU and SCDU regression models are mentioned but no coefficients or fit metrics are reported for them. Note that 'Input Stream to the Platforming unit' (variable 9) functions both as a KIV predictor in the discriminant function and as the denominator (Platforming load) in the SEC definition; it is recorded once in each role. Energy vector for the dependent variable is 'multiple' because SCPU combines fuel gas and steam.
